inputs.52.text: 1980s Japanese theatrical anime cel animation in a gothic, aesthetic register: fine, sharp ink linework with long tapering strokes, hard-edged two-tone cel shading, deep indigo and blue-black shadow tones, a restrained palette with deep crimson and lamp-gold accents. Hand-painted background art with dense architectural detail. Baker Street, London, on a June morning in 1902, a quiet, deserted morning street seen from the roadway at eye level. At screen left the black Georgian front door of 221B with a semicircular fanlight above it and three worn stone steps; a terrace of soot-darkened brick houses with white sash windows runs into depth; at screen right a black iron gas street lamp stands at the kerb. Low, sharp morning sunlight rakes across the facades, laying long deep indigo shadows across the pavement and the cobbled road.
